shortDescription: Owners of nearly 30 Lukoil PJSC filling stations in Pennsylvania and New Jersey can proceed with a lawsuit accusing the Russian oil giant of overcharging franchisees, according to Bloomberg.The case centers on fuel pricing at the stations.

title: Lukoil Must Face Franchisee Fuel-Pricing Lawsuit
